technique_roles: sparse broken dry-crayon and contour-line construction

positive_prompt: Monochrome lithograph language built from sparse broken dry-crayon contours and pressure-varied lines; visible paper tooth; radical simplification; paper-white negative space; restrained dark accents; limited localized hatching or grain; translate only source-photo structures.
negative_prompt: Do not copy or invent the reference road, sign, utility poles, wires, landscape, horizon, or composition. No continuous heavy outline, rubbed-gray background, filled tonal haze, dense crosshatching, photorealistic detail, generated text, decorative frame, route line, marker, watermark, collage seam, or rectangular plate edge.
finishing_notes: use the reference only for line construction, negative space, dark accents, simplification, and limited texture
concentrate hatching only where structure or depth requires it
derive no road, sign, poles, wires, landscape, or reference composition

mark_edge_quality: sparse broken dry-crayon contours with visible paper tooth
pressure variation, loose retracing, and selective line omission
negative_space_rules: keep open areas paper-white rather than filling them with gray
do not translate the reference road, sign, poles, wires, or landscape into the new subject
fill_tonal_rules: use restrained dark anchors and limited localized hatching
forbid rubbed-gray bases and continuous tonal haze
background_cleanliness: empty areas match the shared paper master
no generated background noise, gray cast, or rectangular plate patch
sample_style_contract_defaults.frame_border_policy: forbid generated frames, borders, crop edges, and plate seams
sample_style_contract_defaults.abstraction_level: radical structural simplification that preserves the source photo's primary read and imports no reference subject
